title: Boundary KML Downloader: Place Outlines as Files
description: Download a city, county or region boundary as KML or GeoJSON with the Boundary KML Downloader — preview on the map, area included. Free.
summary_sentence: Search for an OSM polygon and inspect the matched name and returned geometry before downloading.
quick_answer: Search for a place and retrieve the first polygon among up to five Nominatim matches. Download the returned geometry as KML or GeoJSON; the approximate spherical area is not an official land-area figure.
steps_intro: A place name in, a boundary file out:

body.t: A clean jurisdiction outline drops into slides and PDFs without tracing screenshots. Pair with the
when the report zooms out to nations.
Service areas, sales territories and study extents all start from an administrative outline — download it here, then clip your data against it in QGIS or ArcGIS.
KML is Earth’s native tongue: the downloaded file opens as a placemark polygon you can style, label and fly to.
A vendor’s coverage map says ‘the whole county’. Download the county and overlay — the outline either agrees or the conversation changes.

examples.label: Example · What is inside the file

body.t: A KML boundary is a Placemark holding a Polygon whose outerBoundaryIs ring lists longitude,latitude pairs around the place. The GeoJSON flavour carries the same outline as a Polygon or MultiPolygon feature — one geometry, two envelopes.
Returned MultiPolygon features can contain detached parts; their coverage depends on the source record. The map preview fits only the first outer ring.

popular_table.title: KML or GeoJSON — which download?
rows: GIS work, web development, data pipelines
Coordinates are longitude first in both files
popular_table.note: Boundaries come from open map data (OpenStreetMap’s administrative records): excellent for general work, while legal jurisdiction questions belong to official survey sources.

faq: Cities, counties, regions and other administrative areas present in the open boundary data — from US counties and German Landkreise to French communes. Very small or unmapped jurisdictions may not have a recorded outline.
KML for the Google Earth world and GeoJSON for GIS and web work. Both hold the same WGS84 outline; only the envelope differs.
Can I download several places at once?
One place per download keeps files clean and named. For a set, download each and merge in your GIS — boundaries combine trivially as features.
Why does the outline look simplified on the map?
The map preview fits the first outer ring only. The export contains the returned geometry, including other polygon parts where present.
Does it include ZIP code boundaries?
ZIPs are postal, not administrative — the dedicated ZIP boundary tools on this site cover that family. Administrative places live here.
Can I edit the boundary after downloading?
Yes — the file is yours. Edit vertices in QGIS or Google Earth; just remember an edited outline is your geometry, not the source’s record.
What about disputed or changing boundaries?
The file reflects the open data’s current documented position. Annexations and disputes resolve in the data over time, not in this downloader.
